I enjoy sports, skiing, biking, and photography. 

Hope to welcome you soon – at my place or yours!

host_about:
I am a writer, translator & photographer. When in Oslo, I stay in this quiet and centrally located artist´s place. I will be available to you when you let me know that you  want me to. I will, however, not disturb an independent traveller. Let me know what you need and want. 

I am fond of music: jazz, classical, folk, Indian and European. Am fond of cinema too, and, of course, of books. I am certainly fond of, and curious about, people. 

I am deeply concerned about the destruction of nature and the climate systems we all depend on. 

I know my part of the city well, the green lungs and the streets, some the museums, the East End as well as the West End of the city. My place is located in the Centre, just to the west of the river that runs through the city.

When not in Oslo, I am most of the time committed to folk song and folk art projects in eastern parts of India and northern parts of Bangladesh, dedicated to amazing and vanishing traditions, be it in song or in yoga and colours. I am committed to artists and children there. I also have a special connection to Central-Eastern Europe, especially Budapest, where I usually spend a month every year, mainly concentrating on photography - or on a manuscript.

Jeg elsker natur, mat, familien min, mine kollegaer, trening og ikke minst jobben min. Jeg er veldig nysgjerrig og uredd som både kan gjøre at jeg noen ganger havner i merkelige situasjoner. Men som oftest har det gitt mer lærdom og erfaring. 

Livet er for kort til å la vær å leves og det starter ofte med et godt hvilested.

Velkommen til mitt hjem :-)

host_about:
Hi!

I'm a little spontaneous norwegian  girl who loves to travel and meet new people. Usually I spend most my winters snowboarding, working and studying, while I use my summers to travel as much as possible. Other than I'm a creative little goof, who tries to make it as a graphic designer.

host_about:

description: PLS READ FULL DESCRIPTION & HOUSE RULES BEFORE BOOKING. Cosy & bright room (12m2) with SHARED kitchen and bathroom, located in central & a stone throw away from Royal Castle. Fancy neighbourhood within walking distance to tourist points, shopping st, embassy, restaurants, coffee shops, bakery, take away & supermarket. Easy access from/to airport & Oslo Central Station. host_about:
Hi, we are Kim & Jen,

We are avid traveler and love to try new food. We love to meet interesting people from all around the world. We live in central Oslo, a fancy and lively neighbourhood a stone throw away from Royal Castle. We love Airbnb as part of channeling our joy of hosting travelers who understand that choosing this Airbnb is to experience staying someone's home not at hotel. 

Jen is a freelance designer & works from home. She spends her free time sketching/painting, reading, gardening & attending opera & ballet shows. She loves mini dachshund but unfortunately she doesnt have one yet. She grew up & lived in many countries before moved to Oslo. Her fave cities are Istanbul, Tokyo, Seville and Granada. 

Kim works at Opera House. He spend a lot of his time at gym and making music. He has been playing guitar and drum since he was young. Sometimes he has gig in the town with his band. He loves spicy food. He has been traveling to many countries, some of his favourite are Thailand and South American countries.

We have been traveling around for many years and have been using airbnb service, while we are not traveling we decided to share our home with others travelers who are visiting our beautiful city. We love the idea to open our home to host traveler from around the world.

name: Central and design savvy flat, month of july rent!
description: If you´ve always wondered how you compare to the worlds tallest man (Robert Wadlow) - my place is perfect for you. host_about:
I work and live in the city of Oslo, and practice as an architect - hence the customized apartment.  My house is an attempt to optimize by staging every activity done here, from cooking, reading in the library  - sketching on a project or quietly contemplating life´s small and large events.  Balance is key!

Other than enjoying a life as an architect, I spend most weekends with friends or family - hopefully traveling somewhere soothing, enjoying the company, making a thing out of it!  To put the cherry on the pie - yes, I also own a classic car.  Now realizing as I write this - I´m as ordinary as any architect could be. 

On my door is one of my few everlasting motto´s : No rain, no potatoes.  

I grew up on a farm - but also in the Malaysian city of Kuala Lumpur.  While living there as a kid, the custom of meeting people with an open-minded smile was most inspiring - something I try to remind myself of when hosting people or traveling about.

Hope you´ll enjoy my apartment!

name: Beautiful studio apt. in the heart of Oslo!
description: Welcome to a perfect place for solo adventurers, couples, and business travellers! This charming studio will make you feel like home due to its coziness and the best location in Oslo. It's modern, light, convenient, situated on a quiet side street, yet just a few minutes away from a lively city centre. In this part of Oslo, named Frogner, you will find art galleries, antique stores, places to eat and drink, whether you are looking for a nice gourmet restaurant or a cosy neighbourhood café.
host_about:
Hello travellers! 
I am happy to live in times when people are more mobile than ever, traveling is easy and communities emerge thanks to such amazing services as Airbnb! 
I like the concept introduced by Taiye Selasi about being "multi-local" referring to people "who feel at home in the town where they grew up, the city they live now and maybe another place or two" - this describes me very well. I was born and raised in a multi-ethnic Kyrgyz Republic, graduated from a high school in the US, and now live and work in Oslo for almost 12 years. 

My professional background is in Radio & TV. Currently I work in a tech company providing online marketing services. Good conversations, long walks, dancing and being in the mountains are some of my energy sources. 

I love people and I love travelling, so Airbnb is my kind of service! I traveled and used Airbnb in Portugal, Spain, the US, Poland, Belize, Mexico, Belgium and absolutely loved it! My name is Marcus and I live in Oslo with my wife Mana. I am a traveller and travel as often as i can. Our aim is to make your stay here in Oslo as pleasant and trouble free as possible. We hope that you chose to stay again when you next visit our fair city.

Kind regards,
Mana & Marcus

name: Sjarmerende studioleilighet på Bygdøy
description:
Cozy studio apartment with garden and direct access to Kongeskogen – near the beach, museums and city center

Welcome to our newly renovated and charming basement apartment on beautiful Bygdøy – one of Oslo's most attractive areas.
The apartment has a separate bedroom with a large and comfortable double bed, as well as a living room with a double sofa bed – which makes it well suited for up to 4 people. The apartment has a separate entrance from the garden and is located right next to Kongeskogen, with direct access to trails and hiking terrain.

To open up your home, i imagine you must be enjoying meeting people from all over the world as we do.
